name: VisionaryWings
storyline:
Visionary Wings is a popular online game these days.
What makes it different from other games is that it uses a DLS interface. I'm not familiar with the technical details, but it's essentially a system that directly accesses your brain, allowing you to move your limbs in the same way as in real life, and experience things with all five senses.

Apparently, this game evolved from a flight simulator to its current form, hence the name, but you can fly in the sky. I think that's one of the reasons for its popularity.

I've been participating since the beta, and recently the number of people has really increased.
What was once a village now feels like a city.

As the population increased, so did the number of problems.
Naturally, there are no police in this world.
So the townspeople formed a community to protect themselves.

Item theft, murderer extermination, person search, escort, etc...

Being the type of person who can't help but get involved in any incident, I naturally participated.

"Master, do you have any suitable requests?"
summary:
A bullet-hell shooting game with around 3000 bullets.
Its selling points are its inflated scoring system and beautiful pre-rendered graphics.
